race.comment: PURGATORIO (12) resumes having been well backed on debut at Echuca and running a strong race, getting into third behind an impressive winner in a race that rated very highly off a fast tempo. Since spelled, he should be an improver and will go close. EARTHBOUND (8) is a gelding by Overshare on debut for the Jusufovic yard who debuts. He's been jumping out very nicely on numerous occasions and his brother has been a strong horse for connections. FASTER LINK (10)  is a Spirit Of Boom gelding for the Greg Eurell yard who debuts. Blake Shinn booked is a strong lead, respecting. ENEA (9) is a Satono Aladdin gelding on debut for the Price & Kent Jnr yard who warrants respect despite a wide gate. Watch the market.
